values.quote: flying wildly around it for 5 seconds

values.binNote: The bin has no explicit tick-interval field; 0.25 is only implicit in FiddleSticksR#DamageDone's *0.25 multiplier applied to the per-second DamagePerSecond/APRatio terms, which is a damage calculation, not a stated interval value.

values.meaning: Channel time before blinking and dealing damage

mechanics.claim: Fiddlesticks channels before blinking to the target location; the channel is not interrupted by roots.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Root|Roots}} do not {{tip|interrupt}} the ability despite being a [[Channel#Movement Channels|movement channel]].

mechanics.claim: Fiddlesticks will always blink to the intended location even if its position changes during the channel, so long as the channel isn't interrupted.
mechanics.quote: '''Fiddlesticks''' will always {{tip|blink}} to its intended location even if its position changes during the {{tip|channel}} without being interrupted

mechanics.claim: Damage begins only after the channel completes and Fiddlesticks blinks in, dealing damage every 0.25s for 5 seconds to nearby enemies.
mechanics.quote: then {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location upon completion with a murder of crows flying wildly around it for 5 seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: The channel is interrupted by death, silence, or being grounded.
The ability's cooldown starts on cast (i.e., at channel start, not after the channel completes).
